senses.gloss: f. (זהר; v. P. Sm. 1115 s. v. זחור׳) crimson; crocus; crimson (or safran) colored material, esp. silk (b. h. .
units: Kel. XXVII, 12 ז׳ טובה fine crimsom silk.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:6:5">Y. Succ. III, 53ᵈ</cite> (defining <cite ref="A00420"><he>אדמדם</he></cite>) <he>ז׳ עמוקה</he> deep crimsom.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 26:1">Pesik. R. s. 26</cite> <he>ומלבשתן ז׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="G00089"><he>זהורים</he></cite>) and clads them in silk.

<cite ref="Niddah 25b:19">Nidd. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>כב׳ … של זְהוֹרִין</he> like two threads of silk (woof); <he>כב׳ … זהורית</he> (prob. to be read <cite ref="G00089"><he>זְהוֹרוֹת</he></cite>) like two threads of silk (warp); Y. ib. III, 50ᵈ <he>של זהורות</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:8">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:8">Yoma VI, 8</cite> <he>לשון של ז׳</he> a crimson-colored strap.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:5">Tosef. Sabb. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 5:5">V</cite>), 5 <he>ז׳ שבין עיניו</he> crimson ornament between his (the horse’s) eyes; <cite ref="Shabbat 53a">Sabb. 53ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="G00111"><he>זַהֲרוּרִית</he></cite> (Ar. <he>זהור׳</he>); a. e.—Pl. <he>זְהוֹרִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:9">Tosef. Sot. XV, 9</cite> <he>ז׳ מוזהבות</he> (<cite ref="Sotah 49b:7">Sot. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>זהורית מוזהבות</he>, corr. acc.) gold-embroidered silks used for brides’ canopies.
